themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Articles discussing AI agents that can autonomously perform research tasks, analyze data, or interact with systems to achieve research goals.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Content focusing on AI tools that assist developers in writing, debugging, and understanding code, including insights into their capabilities and limitations.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Articles about AI systems that condense large amounts of text or data into concise summaries, aiding in rapid information processing.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Tools and platforms that leverage AI to facilitate or enhance various stages of the research process, from data collection to analysis.

themes.name: AI testing automation
themes.description: Focuses on AI applications in automating software testing processes, improving efficiency and effectiveness in quality assurance.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Research and discussions on how AI is changing job roles, skills requirements, and the overall employment landscape.

themes.name: AI design research
themes.description: Articles exploring how AI is being used to inform, assist, or transform the design process for user interfaces and experiences.

themes.name: AI sentiment feedback
themes.description: Content related to using AI to analyze and understand user sentiment, feedback, and opinions from various sources.

themes.name: AI customer insights
themes.description: Articles detailing how AI is employed to extract valuable insights from customer data for business improvement.

themes.name: AI conversational AI in research
themes.description: Explores the use of AI-powered chatbots and conversational agents in conducting interviews, gathering data, and interacting with users for research purposes.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
